arguments.sql:
WITH single_comments AS (
    SELECT MAX(c.Score) AS score
    FROM main.comments AS c
    JOIN main.posts AS p ON p.Id = c.PostId
    GROUP BY c.PostId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_score_comments
FROM single_comments
WHERE score = 0;
